### Load libs

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(Orpheus)
library(tidyverse)
library(sparseMatrixStats)
```

### Define waveform and theory helpers

Cell rhythms are short harmonic sums w(t) = sum_k b_k cos(k t - psi_k) using odd harmonics only, so w(t - pi) = -w(t). Waves are normalized so (max - min)/2 = 1, which means A_true is still half the peak-to-trough distance. The fundamental (not the peak) is aligned to t = 0.

```{r}
eval_wave <- function(t, wave) {
  out <- 0
  for (h in seq_along(wave$k)) {
    out <- out + wave$b[h] * cos(wave$k[h] * t - wave$psi[h])
  }
  out
}

make_wave <- function(waveform = "cosine", n_harmonics = 3, custom_wave = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(custom_wave)) {
    wave <- custom_wave
    waveform <- "custom"
  } else {
    k_odd <- c(1, 3, 5)[seq_len(n_harmonics)]
    wave <- switch(waveform,
      cosine   = list(k = 1, b = 1, psi = 0),
      square   = list(k = k_odd, b = (-1)^(seq_along(k_odd) - 1) / k_odd, psi = rep(0, length(k_odd))),
      triangle = list(k = k_odd, b = 1 / k_odd^2, psi = rep(0, length(k_odd))),
      # cosine2: cos(t) + 0.5*cos(3t - pi/2), i.e. the per2 = per/3, pha2 = pha1 + per2/4 wave in radians
      cosine2  = list(k = c(1, 3), b = c(1, 0.5), psi = c(0, pi/2)),
      stop("Unknown waveform: ", waveform)
    )
  }
  # Normalize so half of peak-to-trough = 1 (cosine stays exactly b = 1)
  grid <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 4001)
  w <- eval_wave(grid, wave)
  wave$b <- wave$b / ((max(w) - min(w)) / 2)
  wave$name <- waveform
  wave
}

# Exact mean and variance of counts at times t for a gene with cell rhythm
# lambda = G + A*w(t + phase_noise - shift) + epsilon, phase_noise ~ N(0, phi_sd^2),
# and counts | lambda with Var = lambda + theta*lambda^2 (theta = 0 is Poisson).
theoretical_moments <- function(t, G, A, theta, phi_sd, epsilon_sd, wave, shift = 0) {
  k <- wave$k
  b <- wave$b
  psi <- wave$psi + k * shift
  rho <- function(nu) exp(-nu^2 * phi_sd^2 / 2)

  osc_mean <- eval_wave(t, list(k = k, b = b * rho(k), psi = psi))
  mu <- G + A * osc_mean

  # E[w(t + noise)^2]
  osc_sq <- 0
  for (j in seq_along(k)) {
    for (l in seq_along(k)) {
      osc_sq <- osc_sq + b[j] * b[l] / 2 *
        (rho(k[j] - k[l]) * cos((k[j] - k[l]) * t - psi[j] + psi[l]) +
         rho(k[j] + k[l]) * cos((k[j] + k[l]) * t - psi[j] - psi[l]))
    }
  }
  E_lambda2 <- G^2 + epsilon_sd^2 + 2 * G * A * osc_mean + A^2 * osc_sq
  V <- mu + (1 + theta) * E_lambda2 - mu^2
  list(mu = mu, V = V)
}

# Continuous Fourier truth, using the same conventions as is_cycling() / var_cycling_fix_acro():
# V_w is the variance fundamental in phase with the bulk, V_2w is the coefficient on
# cos(2(t - pi/2 - phase_bulk)) and V_2w_quad is the out-of-phase 12h part.
theoretical_fourier <- function(G, A, theta, phi_sd, epsilon_sd, wave, shift = 0) {
  t <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 257)[-257]
  mom <- theoretical_moments(t, G, A, theta, phi_sd, epsilon_sd, wave, shift)
  proj <- function(x, f) 2 * mean(x * f)
  phase_bulk <- atan2(proj(mom$mu, sin(t)), proj(mom$mu, cos(t)))
  beta <- pi + 2 * phase_bulk
  c2 <- proj(mom$V, cos(2*t))
  s2 <- proj(mom$V, sin(2*t))
  c(S_amp = sqrt(proj(mom$mu, cos(t))^2 + proj(mom$mu, sin(t))^2),
    V_DC = mean(mom$V),
    V_w = proj(mom$V, cos(t - phase_bulk)),
    V_2w = c2 * cos(beta) + s2 * sin(beta),
    V_2w_quad = -c2 * sin(beta) + s2 * cos(beta))
}

# Phi that the Orpheus pipeline converges to with infinitely many cells: run the
# is_cycling / var_cycling_fix_acro / find_analytic steps on noise-free mean and variance
# at the sampled time points.
oracle_phi <- function(time_points, G, A, theta, phi_sd, epsilon_sd, wave, shift = 0) {
  mom <- theoretical_moments(time_points, G, A, theta, phi_sd, epsilon_sd, wave, shift)
  mu <- mom$mu
  V <- mom$V
  cf <- coef(lm(mu ~ sin(time_points) + cos(time_points)))
  S_DC <- cf[[1]]
  S_amp <- sqrt(cf[[2]]^2 + cf[[3]]^2)
  phase_bulk <- atan2(cf[[2]], cf[[3]]) %% (2*pi)
  double_wave <- cos(2 * (time_points - pi/2 - phase_bulk))
  full_model <- lm(V ~ double_wave + mu)
  fitted_fund <- full_model$coefficients[["mu"]] * mu
  fund_amp <- coef(lm(fitted_fund ~ cos(time_points - phase_bulk)))[[2]]
  suppressWarnings(find_analytic(full_model$coefficients[["double_wave"]], fund_amp, S_amp, S_DC)[4])
}

# Count draws. ZINB: NB counts with a gene-wise structural-zero probability pi0.
draw_counts <- function(mu, theta, dist, pi0 = 0) {
  switch(dist,
    nb      = rnbinom(length(mu), size = 1/theta, mu = mu),
    poisson = rpois(length(mu), mu),
    zinb    = {
      x <- rnbinom(length(mu), size = 1/theta, mu = mu)
      x[runif(length(mu)) < pi0] <- 0L
      x
    },
    stop("Unknown dist: ", dist)
  )
}
```

### Define simulation function

```{r}
simulate_scRNAseq_circadian <- function(n = 10000, m = 5000, p_circ = 0.3,n_time_points = 6,
                                        phi_sd = 0.3, amp_ratio_range = c(.3, 0.75), G_range = c(0.05, 5), epsilon_sd = 0.,
                                        theta_range = c(0.01,2.5), seed = 123,
                                        waveform = "cosine", n_harmonics = 3, custom_wave = NULL,
                                        dist = c("nb", "poisson", "zinb"), zi_prob_range = c(0.05, 0.3)) {
  dist <- match.arg(dist)
  wave <- make_wave(waveform, n_harmonics, custom_wave)
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # Time points
  time_points <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = n_time_points) # Discrete time points for sampling
  cell_time_indices <- sort(sample(1:n_time_points, n, replace = TRUE))
  t_vals <- time_points[cell_time_indices] # Actual time for each cell
  
  # Assign circadian vs non-circadian genes
  n_circ <- round(p_circ * m)
  stopifnot(n_circ <= m)
  circadian_gene_indices <- 1:n_circ # Row indices for circadian genes
  
  # Initialize expression matrix
  expr_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = m, ncol = n)
  gene_names <- paste0("Gene", 1:m)
  rownames(expr_matrix) <- gene_names
  colnames(expr_matrix) <- paste0("Cell", 1:n)
  
  # Initialize data frame to store gene parameters
  gene_parameters <- data.frame(
    gene_id = gene_names,
    theta_true = 0,
    A_true = 0, # Amplitude, will be 0 for non-circadian
    G_true = 0, # Baseline expression
    V_w_theoret = 0,
    V_2w_theoret = 0,
    V_DC_theoret = 0,
    S_amp_theoret = 0,
    V_2w_quad_theoret = 0,
    phi_oracle = NA_real_,
    pi0_true = 0, # Zero-inflation probability (ZINB only)
    theta_eff = 0, # Dispersion seen by Orpheus: (theta + pi0)/(1 - pi0)
    waveform = wave$name,
    dist = dist,
    is_circadian = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  rownames(gene_parameters) <- gene_names
  
  
  # Simulate circadian genes
  if (n_circ > 0) {
    for (i in 1:n_circ) {
      gene_idx <- circadian_gene_indices[i] # Actual row index in expr_matrix
      
      #Select amp ratio
      Amp_ratio_val <- runif(1, amp_ratio_range[1], amp_ratio_range[2])
      #Select MESOR
      G_val <- runif(1, G_range[1], G_range[2])
      A_val <- Amp_ratio_val * G_val
      stopifnot(A_val <= G_val) # Ensure baseline is at least amplitude (should be)
      theta <- if (dist == "poisson") 0 else runif(1, theta_range[1], theta_range[2])
      pi0 <- if (dist == "zinb") runif(1, zi_prob_range[1], zi_prob_range[2]) else 0

      # Odd genes have their fundamental peak at t=0, even genes at t=pi
      shift <- if (gene_idx %% 2) 0 else pi

      # ZINB with constant pi0 is NB in the observed mean m = (1-pi0)*lambda, with
      # theta_eff = (theta + pi0)/(1 - pi0). Poisson is theta = 0. So one formula covers all three.
      theta_eff <- (theta + pi0) / (1 - pi0)
      G_eff <- (1 - pi0) * G_val
      A_eff <- (1 - pi0) * A_val
      eps_eff <- (1 - pi0) * epsilon_sd
      theo <- theoretical_fourier(G_eff, A_eff, theta_eff, phi_sd, eps_eff, wave, shift)


      # Store parameters
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "A_true"] <- A_val
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "G_true"] <- G_val
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "theta_true"] <- theta
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "pi0_true"] <- pi0
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "theta_eff"] <- theta_eff
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "is_circadian"] <- TRUE
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "V_w_theoret"] <- theo[["V_w"]]
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "V_2w_theoret"] <- theo[["V_2w"]]
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "V_2w_quad_theoret"] <- theo[["V_2w_quad"]]
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "V_DC_theoret"] <- theo[["V_DC"]]
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "S_amp_theoret"] <- theo[["S_amp"]]
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "phi_oracle"] <- oracle_phi(time_points, G_eff, A_eff, theta_eff, phi_sd,
                                                            eps_eff, wave, shift)


      phases_w_noise <- t_vals + rnorm(n, 0, phi_sd) # Cell-specific phase noise
      cell_specific_epsilon_noise <- rnorm(n, 0, epsilon_sd) # Cell-specific expression noise
      # repeat_nums <- table(t_vals)
      # cell_specific_epsilon_noise <- rep(rnorm(n_time_points, 0, epsilon_sd), times = repeat_nums)

      lambdas <- A_val * eval_wave(phases_w_noise - shift, wave) + G_val + cell_specific_epsilon_noise

      # Ensure lambdas are non-negative (rpois requires lambda >= 0)
      non_negative_lambdas <- pmax(0, lambdas)


      # For NB, mu is the mean. Size controls dispersion.
      # var = mu + mu^2/size. If size=1, var = mu + mu^2. For large mu, var ~ mu^2.
      counts <- draw_counts(non_negative_lambdas, theta, dist, pi0)

      
      expr_matrix[gene_idx, ] <- counts
    }
  }
  
  # Simulate non-circadian genes
  non_circadian_gene_indices <- setdiff(1:m, circadian_gene_indices)
  if (length(non_circadian_gene_indices) > 0) {
    for (gene_idx in non_circadian_gene_indices) {
      G_val <- runif(1, G_range[1], G_range[2])
      theta <- if (dist == "poisson") 0 else runif(1, theta_range[1], theta_range[2])
      pi0 <- if (dist == "zinb") runif(1, zi_prob_range[1], zi_prob_range[2]) else 0

      # Store parameters (A is already 0, is_circadian is already FALSE)
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "G_true"] <- G_val
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "theta_true"] <- theta
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "pi0_true"] <- pi0
      gene_parameters[gene_idx, "theta_eff"] <- (theta + pi0) / (1 - pi0)
      
      
      cell_specific_epsilon_noise <- rnorm(n, 0, epsilon_sd)
      # repeat_nums <- table(t_vals)
      # cell_specific_epsilon_noise <- rep(rnorm(n_time_points, 0, epsilon_sd), times = repeat_nums)
      mus <- G_val + cell_specific_epsilon_noise
      
      non_negative_mus <- pmax(0, mus)
      counts <- draw_counts(non_negative_mus, theta, dist, pi0)

      
      expr_matrix[gene_idx, ] <- counts
    }
  }
  
  # Metadata for cells
  cell_metadata <- data.frame(
    cell_id = colnames(expr_matrix),
    time_point = t_vals # The "true" sampled time for each cell
  )
  
  # Identify which gene names are circadian (can be derived from gene_parameters too)
  circadian_gene_names <- gene_parameters$gene_id[gene_parameters$is_circadian]
  
  return(list(
    counts = expr_matrix, 
    cell_metadata = cell_metadata, 
    gene_parameters = gene_parameters,
    circadian_gene_ids = circadian_gene_names, # More informative than just indices
    wave = wave # Normalized harmonic coefficients used for the cell rhythms
  ))
}

```

### Waveforms tested

Normalized cell rhythms (solid) and the bulk mean they produce after 3 hrs of phase dispersion (dashed).

```{r}
wave_names = c("cosine", "square", "triangle", "cosine2")
wave_df = lapply(wave_names, function(wf) {
  wave = make_wave(wf)
  t = seq(0, 2*2*pi, length.out = 400) #two wavelengths
  data.frame(waveform = wf, ZT = t*12/pi,
             cell = eval_wave(t, wave),
             bulk = theoretical_moments(t, G = 0, A = 1, theta = 0, phi_sd = 3/12*pi, epsilon_sd = 0, wave = wave)$mu)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(waveform = factor(waveform, levels = wave_names))

waveform_plot = ggplot(wave_df, aes(x = ZT)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cell)) +
  #geom_line(aes(y = bulk), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~waveform, nrow = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 48, by = 6)) +
  xlab("ZT (hrs)") +
  ylab("Normalized expression") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12))
waveform_plot
ggsave("~/Desktop/Simulated_waveforms_2x2.pdf", plot = waveform_plot, width = 10, height = 10, units = "in")
```

### Simulate realistic data (params from hepatocytes in liver data)

```{r}
output = list()
for(s in seq_len(nrow(sim_settings))){
  wf = sim_settings$waveform[s]
  dist = sim_settings$dist[s]
  # for(i in seq(0, 4.5, by = 0.5)){
  for(i in seq(0, 7, by = 0.5)){
    print(paste0(wf, ", ", dist, ", phi = ", i))
    phi_sd = i/12*pi
    epsilon_sd = 0.3
    #These were numbers based on hepatocytes 2
    # sim <- simulate_scRNAseq_circadian(n = 5000, m = 10000, p_circ = .25, phi_sd = phi_sd, n_time_points = 6,
    #               amp_ratio_range = c(.2, 0.6), G_range = c(0.1, 5), epsilon_sd = epsilon_sd, theta_range = c(0.1,2.0))
    #These are numbers based on hepatocytes 1
    sim <- simulate_scRNAseq_circadian(n = 8000, m = 10000, p_circ = .1, phi_sd = phi_sd, n_time_points = 6,
                  amp_ratio_range = c(.15, 0.75), G_range = c(0.1, 5), epsilon_sd = epsilon_sd, theta_range = c(0.1, 1.2),
                  waveform = wf, dist = dist)

    counts <- sim$counts
    metadata <- sim$cell_metadata
    gene_info <- sim$gene_parameters

    seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, meta.data = metadata)
    seurat_obj$orig.ident = seurat_obj$time_point
    seurat_obj$seurat_clusters = "0"

    s_obj = prepare_seurat_for_orpheus(seurat_obj = seurat_obj)
    orpheus_inputs = calculate_orpheus_inputs(s_obj, groups_to_analyze = "0", grouping_var = "seurat_clusters")

    tmp = orpheus_inputs[[1]]
    pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
    var_mat = tmp[[2]]
    counts = tmp[[3]]

    #Variance of NB is var = mean + mean^2*theta
    #rearrange to solve for theta = (var-mean)/mean^2
    #(for ZINB this measures theta_eff = (theta + pi0)/(1 - pi0); for Poisson it should be ~0)
    vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
    means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
    agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
    rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)

    # summary(agg_theta_meas$coarse_theta)
    #
    # summary(means)

    ZT = as.numeric(colnames(pb_mat) )

    pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat, time_units = "rad")
    circ_genes = pb_cycling %>% filter(as.numeric(p_statistic) < 0.05) %>% select(Gene_Symbols) %>% unname %>% unlist
    circ_genes_phases = pb_cycling %>% filter(as.numeric(p_statistic) < 0.05) %>% select(acrophase_bulk)  %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric

    # length(circ_genes)
    # pb_cycling %>% filter(as.numeric(p_statistic) < 0.05) %>% select(amp_ratio) %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric %>% summary

    var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(ZT, var_mat[circ_genes,], pb_mat[circ_genes,], phase_pb = circ_genes_phases, time_units = "rad")

    phi = calc_phi( pb_cycling, var_cyclers, bulk_amp_thr = 0 )
    
    input = var_cyclers %>% 
      left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix= c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
      mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
      filter(p_statistic < 0.05 & double_freq_p_statistic < 1) %>%
      # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
      # mutate(keep_acrodiff = acrodiff < (pi / 2 + expected_acrodiff_thr) & acrodiff > (pi / 2 - expected_acrodiff_thr)) %>%
      # filter(keep_acrodiff == TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp, amplitude_bulk,mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
      column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
      # filter( amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%
      # select(c(1:5)) %>%
      filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)
    
    plot_df = merge(input, phi, by = 0) %>%
      merge(., gene_info, by.x="Row.names", by.y = 0)%>%
      mutate(phase_error = (phi -phi_sd ))
    plot_df$phi_true = phi_sd
    # out = merge(plot_df, time_wise_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
    out = merge(plot_df, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
    
    output <- append(output, list(out))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#Same style as the plot above, for a subset of settings in one row
plot_phi_acc_subset = function(plot_data, settings_to_plot) {
  plot_data = plot_data %>%
    filter(setting %in% settings_to_plot) %>%
    mutate(setting = factor(setting, levels = settings_to_plot))

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = phi_true*12/pi, y = phi*12/pi))+
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = phi_true_factor, fill = phi_true*12/pi), outlier.shape = NA)+
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", name = "true phase\ndispersion (hrs)") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_wrap(~setting, nrow = 1) +
    xlab("True phase std. (hrs)")+
    ylab("Predicted phase std. (hrs)")+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase x-axis text size
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12)    # Increase legend title size
    )+
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)+
    ylim(c(0, 9))+
    guides(fill = "none")    # remove fill legend
}
```

### Idealized Scenario:

```{r}
output_ideal = list()
for(s in seq_len(nrow(sim_settings))){
  wf = sim_settings$waveform[s]
  dist = sim_settings$dist[s]
  # for(i in seq(0, 4.5, by = 0.5)){
  for(i in seq(0, 7, by = 0.5)){
    print(paste0(wf, ", ", dist, ", phi = ", i))
    phi_sd = i/12*pi
    epsilon_sd = 0.3
    # sim <- simulate_scRNAseq_circadian(n = 24000, m = 10000, p_circ = .25, phi_sd = phi_sd, n_time_points = 12,
    #               amp_ratio_range = c(.2, 0.6), G_range = c(0.1, 5), epsilon_sd = epsilon_sd, theta_range = c(0.1,2.0))
    sim <- simulate_scRNAseq_circadian(n = 24000, m = 10000, p_circ = .1, phi_sd = phi_sd, n_time_points = 12,
                  amp_ratio_range = c(.15, 0.75), G_range = c(0.1, 5), epsilon_sd = epsilon_sd, theta_range = c(0.1, 1.2),
                  waveform = wf, dist = dist)
    
    counts <- sim$counts
    metadata <- sim$cell_metadata
    gene_info <- sim$gene_parameters
    
    seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, meta.data = metadata)
    seurat_obj$orig.ident = seurat_obj$time_point
    seurat_obj$seurat_clusters = "0"
    
    s_obj = prepare_seurat_for_orpheus(seurat_obj = seurat_obj)
    orpheus_inputs = calculate_orpheus_inputs(s_obj, groups_to_analyze = "0", grouping_var = "seurat_clusters")
    
    tmp = orpheus_inputs[[1]]
    pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
    var_mat = tmp[[2]]
    counts = tmp[[3]]
    
    #Variance of NB is var = mean + mean^2*theta
    #rearrange to solve for theta = (var-mean)/mean^2
    vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
    means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
    agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
    rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)

    # summary(agg_theta_meas$coarse_theta)
    # 
    # summary(means)
    
    ZT = as.numeric(colnames(pb_mat) )
    
    pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat, time_units = "rad")
    circ_genes = pb_cycling %>% filter(as.numeric(p_statistic) < 0.05) %>% select(Gene_Symbols) %>% unname %>% unlist
    circ_genes_phases = pb_cycling %>% filter(as.numeric(p_statistic) < 0.05) %>% select(acrophase_bulk)  %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
    
    # length(circ_genes)
    # pb_cycling %>% filter(as.numeric(p_statistic) < 0.05) %>% select(amp_ratio) %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric %>% summary
    
    var_cyclers = var_cycling_fix_acro(ZT, var_mat[circ_genes,], pb_mat[circ_genes,], phase_pb = circ_genes_phases, time_units = "rad")
    phi = calc_phi( pb_cycling, var_cyclers, bulk_amp_thr = 0 )
    input = var_cyclers %>% 
      left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix= c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
      mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
      filter(p_statistic < 0.05 & double_freq_p_statistic < 1) %>%
      # mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
      # mutate(keep_acrodiff = acrodiff < (pi / 2 + expected_acrodiff_thr) & acrodiff > (pi / 2 - expected_acrodiff_thr)) %>%
      # filter(keep_acrodiff == TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp, amplitude_bulk,mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
      column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
      # filter( amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%
      # select(c(1:5)) %>%
      filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)
    
    plot_df = merge(input, phi, by = 0) %>%
      merge(., gene_info, by.x="Row.names", by.y = 0)%>%
      mutate(phase_error = (phi -phi_sd ))
    plot_df$phi_true = phi_sd
    # out = merge(plot_df, time_wise_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
    out = merge(plot_df, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
    
    output_ideal <- append(output_ideal, list(out))
  }
}

df_ideal = do.call(rbind, output_ideal)
```
